newsitem.title: UK: LME aluminium and copper drift lower in late Ldn.
newsitem.headline: LME aluminium and copper drift lower in late Ldn.

text.p: London Metal Exchange (LME) copper drifted further down, below $2,200 per tonne, during inter office activity after it met end-week profit taking and light broker liquidation toward the kerb close.

Copper dipped from a high of $2,218 to settle the kerb at $2,208, down $4 in the day, then felt new late pressure and was bid at $2,192 by 1800 GMT when Comex closed, brokers added. Overall the copper market remained quiet and continued to consolidate. Traders will watch closely the LME stocks data next week on Tuesday and Friday.
Aluminium slipped from its earlier 3-1/2 month high of $1,535 a tonne to end the kerb at $1,530. It was bid weaker at $1,523 by 1800 GMT.
